name: Kudou Aya
source:
-A female news announcer
-Aspiring Journalist
-She sees this case as an important opportunity.
-She has a strong sense of justice.
-Self-righteous

Unable to forgive the despicable criminals, she volunteered herself in the hostage exchange, but she had no way of knowing at the time what kind of state the hospital was already in.
